effectSummary.ko: 선조의 전쟁을 선택하면 첫 선조 적중 뒤 4초간 회오리 피해가 전설 가산 20% 증가합니다. 거인의 심판을 선택하면 적중한 적 수와 관계없이 시전당 자원 20을 한 번 회복합니다. 다른 궁극기는 해금·시전하지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: With War of the Ancestors selected, the first ancestor hit grants +20% legendary-pool Whirlwind damage for 4s. With Titan's Judgment selected, restore 20 resource once on an actual hit, regardless of target count. Never unlock or cast the other ultimate.

description.ko: 8초간 선조 2명을 불러냅니다. 각 선조는 1초마다 주위 6m 안의 적 하나에게 D65% 물리 추가 피해를 주며 총 8회씩 공격합니다. 그동안 자신이 받는 피해가 15% 감소합니다. 선조는 별도 몸체나 도발 판정을 갖지 않습니다.
description.en: Call 2 ancestors for 8s. Each attacks one enemy within 6m each second for D65% secondary physical damage, up to 8 attacks each. Take 15% less damage while active. Ancestors have no blocking body or taunt.

description.ko: 0.9초 준비 후 4m 안의 최대 8명에게 D600% 물리 피해와 2초 기절을 줍니다. 이후 6초간 분쇄 일격·지면 강타의 직접 피해가 가산 25% 증가합니다. 보스 기절은 제압 수치로 바꿉니다.
description.en: After a 0.9s wind-up, deal D600% physical damage and a 2s stun to up to 8 enemies within 4m. For 6s, Crush and Slam gain +25% additive direct damage. Boss stun becomes stagger credit.

concept: One ancient king's battle crown-helmet with three broad broken iron crown peaks, a heavy open-faced lower helm and ancestral bronze knotwork carved as large simple material grooves. Deep red inset central stone; no skull, ghost or writing.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LW46, Ancestral King's Crown, class Warrior, slot head armor.
Subject design: One ancient king's battle crown-helmet with three broad broken iron crown peaks, a heavy open-faced lower helm and ancestral bronze knotwork carved as large simple material grooves. Deep red inset central stone; no skull, ghost or writing.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: With War of the Ancestors selected, the first ancestor hit grants +20% legendary-pool Whirlwind damage for 4s. With Titan's Judgment selected, restore 20 resource once on an actual hit, regardless of target count. Never unlock or cast the other ultimate.
Direct skill context: W17 War of the Ancestors — Call 2 ancestors for 8s. Each attacks one enemy within 6m each second for D65% secondary physical damage, up to 8 attacks each. Take 15% less damage while active. Ancestors have no blocking body or taunt.; W18 Titan's Judgment — After a 0.9s wind-up, deal D600% physical damage and a 2s stun to up to 8 enemies within 4m. For 6s, Crush and Slam gain +25% additive direct damage. Boss stun becomes stagger credit.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: square native PNG with real transparent alpha; the built-in 1254 by 1254 output is accepted, and 1024 by 1024 is also accepted. Preserve native pixels and alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Aim to contain the entire subject, including all tips and chain, within the central 76% with generous transparent padding. No part may be clipped or missing. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
